ownership.quote: Since September 2024, we have been a proud member of the Sonio Group. This strategic partnership combines our expertise in cloud computing with Sonio AG's comprehensive IT know-how.

stage.quote: Since its foundation, Flow has remained completely independent, with no pressure from external investors.
stage.note: Founded 2009 and self-financed/bootstrapped for its whole independent history per the founders' own statement and a customer testimonial ('As a self-financed Swiss company, Flow offered the best price performance ratio'). Since September 2024 Flow Swiss AG is a member of the Sonio Group (Sonio AG), a Swiss IT systems-integrator group, which now makes it a subsidiary/group company rather than an independent private firm. No priced VC-style funding round (pre-seed/seed/series) was ever found; the only capital event on record is joining the Sonio Group.

total_funding_usd.basis: Company's own about-us page states it remained completely independent with no external investors from founding (2009) until joining the Sonio Group (Sept 2024); no VC round was ever disclosed.
total_funding_usd.quote: Since its foundation, Flow has remained completely independent, with no pressure from external investors.

last_round.quote: Since September 2024, we have been a proud member of the Sonio Group.

note: Flow Swiss AG is a Zurich-based, bootstrapped/self-financed Swiss cloud provider founded in 2009 by Bojan Jovanovic and Reto Giezendanner. It became a member of the Sonio Group (a Swiss IT systems-integrator/full-service-provider group) in September 2024, described by Flow as a 'strategic partnership'; the terms (majority stake vs. minority investment) were not disclosed on the pages reviewed. No priced VC funding round or ARR/revenue figures were found; all products (Compute, Kubernetes, Object Storage, Mac Bare Metal, CI Engine) are hosted exclusively in Switzerland (Zurich).
